cites.quote: RippleNet takes a user u and an item v as input, and outputs the predicted probability that user u will click item v. A ripple set S k u is the set of knowledge triples that are k-hop(s) away from the seed set V u. These ripple sets are used to interact with the item embedding (the yellow block) iteratively for obtaining the responses of user u with respect to item v (the green blocks), which are then combined to form the final user embedding (the grey block). Lastly, we use the embeddings of user u and item v together to compute the predicted probability ˆ y uv.
